title: 감사 표현: 고맙다, 덕분에, 마음
objective: By the end, you can choose between 고마워 and 감사합니다 for the person you are talking to. You can also use 덕분에, 도움, 마음 and related words in short thank-you sentences.
summary: Learn ten everyday Korean words for saying thank you, giving thanks to someone, and answering when someone thanks you.

task.title: Use thank-you words
task.line: Read each sentence, then choose or write the word from this sheet that fits.

words.meaning: to be thankful (casual form 고마워 is for friends and people younger than you)
to thank (polite; 감사합니다 is used with strangers, customers, and older people)
thanks to (used as 덕분에 after a person or thing that helped you)
words.exampleMeaning: I found my way thanks to my friend.
Tell me if you need help.

words.meaning: to help (the stem 돕- changes to 도와/도우- before endings that start with a vowel: 도와요, 도와서, 도우면)
words.exampleMeaning: I helped my mom and made dinner.

words.meaning: the kind thought or feeling behind something
words.exampleMeaning: The thought matters more than the gift.
It's a small gift. Please take it.

words.meaning: a few words to say hello or thank someone

words.exampleMeaning: A: Thank you. B: You're welcome.

words.meaning: love, deep care for someone (from a parent or teacher, for example)
words.exampleMeaning: I'm always thankful for my parents' love.

exercises: Choose the right word for the person: ① (to a close friend) 책 빌려줘서 (고마워 / 감사합니다). ② (to your manager) 일을 가르쳐 주셔서 (고마워 / 감사합니다).
Fill in the blank with one word: 형 ____에 시험을 잘 봤어요.
Fill in the blanks with 도움 or 돕다 in the right form: ① 이 앱이 한국어 공부에 큰 ____이 돼요. ② 내일 이사를 ____줄 수 있어요?
Fill in the blanks with 선물, 인사, or 사랑: ① 부모님의 ____ 속에서 자랐어요. ② 생일 ____로 꽃을 받았어요. ③ 이웃을 만나면 먼저 ____를 해요.
Choose the best reply: Your neighbor says, "도와줘서 고마워요." (천만에요 / 감사합니다 / 선물이에요)
Fill in the blank with one word: A friend wants to give you an expensive gift, but you politely say no. 정말 고마워. 그런데 ____만 받을게.
answers: ① 사랑 ② 선물 ③ 인사
